children: Shein's stock price is likely to face further downside, says Ipek Ozkardeskaya, senior analyst at Swissquote, a Swiss banking group, in a commentary. Shein's valuation drop comes against a backdrop of complicated geopolitical tensions. "In the short/medium run, the fact that Shein trades at around 15 times forward earnings, roughly double Temu's parent company PDD, suggests that there is room for a further downside correction," Ozkardeskaya says. Investors may stick with AI and robotics players that have bigger potential today, than companies dealing with bigger and growing trade barriers. (tracy.qu@wsj.com)
